episodeTitle.en: The future of AI in software development | Inbal Shani (CPO of GitHub)
episodeTitle.zh: 人工智能在软件开发中的未来 | 因巴尔·沙尼（GitHub首席产品官）

guestBioOfficial.en: Inbal Shani is the chief product officer at GitHub, where she leads core product management, along with product strategy, marketing, open source, and communities, including the development of GitHub Copilot. Prior to joining GitHub, she led engineering and product teams at Amazon and Microsoft. In today’s conversation, we discuss: • What Inbal believes is overhyped and underhyped in the rapidly changing field of AI
guestBioOfficial.zh: 因巴尔·沙尼是GitHub的首席产品官，负责核心产品管理、产品战略、市场营销、开源和社区事务，包括GitHub Copilot的开发。在加入GitHub之前，她曾在亚马逊和微软领导工程和产品团队。在今天的对话中，我们将讨论：•因巴尔认为在快速变化的人工智能领域，哪些东西被过度炒作，哪些被低估了

summary.en: In this conversation, Inbal draws on her experience leading product at high-scale companies to share hard-won lessons on what it takes to build and lead great product organizations. She discusses how product leaders can earn trust, scale decision-making, and grow both their teams and their own careers. The episode is full of practical wisdom for product managers and leaders who want to operate at the highest level.
summary.zh: 在这期对话中，Inbal 结合在大型公司领导产品的经验，分享了打造并领导卓越产品组织的来之不易的教训。她谈到产品领导者如何赢得信任、放大决策规模，以及如何让团队与自己一同成长。这期节目充满面向想在高层面运作的 PM 与领导者的实用智慧。
